analyses.groupDescription: The difference between the active treatment was compared to placebo. For a null hypothesis, the difference would equal 0 (zero).

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description:
Following screening, each subject was randomized to a sequence of 5 dosing periods (Doses A, B, C, D, and E). Each period was separated by a 3- to 14-day washout interval.

The dosing formulations were as follows:

Dose A = placebo Dose B = TrIP-2D (100 μg TrCl formulated in leucine and DPPC) Dose C = TrIP-2SS (100 μg TrCl formulated in leucine and sodium saccharin) Dose D = TrIP-2D (400 μg TrCl) Dose E = TrIP-2SS (100 μg TrCl) + Foradil (12 μg formoterol fumarate) FEV1 (L)was measured at 15 and 30 minutes, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 and 24 hours postdose.

groups.description: Subjects were administered TrIP (100mcg) over 5 dosing periods, each separated by a 3- to 14 day washout period. Subjects reported to the clinic the evening prior to each dose, and assessments were carried out through 24 hours postdose. A 3- to 14-day washout period was maintained between doses. Trospium inhalation powder containing 2% TrCl (100 mcg) formulated in leucine and sodium saccharin, supplied as dry powder in size-2 capsules, was administered via a dry powder inhaler.
groups.title: TrIP-2SS (100mcg)

groups.description: Subjects were administered TrIP (100mcg)plus Foradil (12mcg)over 5 dosing periods, each separated by a 3- to 14 day washout period. Subjects reported to the clinic the evening prior to each dose, and assessments were carried out through 24 hours postdose. A 3- to 14-day washout period was maintained between doses. Foradil (12mcg)and Trospium inhalation powder containing 2% TrCl (100 mcg) formulated in leucine and sodium saccharin, supplied as dry powder in size-2 capsules, was administered via a dry powder inhaler.
groups.title: TrIP-2SS (100mcg) + Foradil (12mcg)

groups.description: Subjects were administered TrIP-2D (100mcg) over 5 dosing periods, each separated by a 3- to 14 day washout period. Subjects reported to the clinic the evening prior to each dose, and assessments were carried out through 24 hours postdose. A 3- to 14-day washout period was maintained between doses. Trospium inhalation powder containing 2% TrCl (100 mcg) formulated in leucine and DPPC; supplied as dry powder in size-2 capsules and administered via dry powder inhaler. One capsule (100 mcg TrCl) or 4 capsules (400 mcg TrCl) were used. A separate inhaler was provided for each capsule.
groups.title: TrIP-2D (100mcg)

Trospium inhalation powder containing 2% TrCl (100 μg) formulated in leucine and DPPC; supplied as dry powder in size-2 capsules and administered via dry powder inhaler.
